dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, I'm going to visit the Grand Palace on Saturday. Are there any rules?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈvɪzɪt ðə ˈɡrænd ˈpæləs ɑːn ˈsætərdeɪ. ər ðɛr ˈɛni ˈruːlz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. You mustn't wear shorts or short skirts there. You have to cover your shoulders.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. juː ˈmʌsənt ˈwɛr ˈʃɔːrts ɔːr ˈʃɔːrt ˈskɜːrts ˈðɛr. juː ˈhæf tə ˈkʌvər jʊr ˈʃoʊldərz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Do I have to wear a long dress?
dialogue.reading: duː aɪ ˈhæf tə ˈwɛr ə ˈlɔːŋ ˈdrɛs?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, you don't have to wear a dress. Jeans are fine.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, juː ˈdoʊnt ˈhæf tə ˈwɛr ə ˈdrɛs. ˈdʒiːnz ər ˈfaɪn.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK. And is there anything I mustn't say?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ənd ɪz ðɛr ˈɛniθɪŋ aɪ ˈmʌsənt ˈseɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thais are very respectful to the royal family. You mustn't say anything rude about them.
dialogue.reading: ˈtaɪz ər ˈvɛri rɪˈspɛktfəl tə ðə ˈrɔɪəl ˈfæməli. juː ˈmʌsənt ˈseɪ ˈɛniθɪŋ ˈruːd əˈbaʊt ðɛm.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I understand. Last time, I saw people kneeling in the temple there. Do I have to kneel, too?
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˌʌndərˈstænd. ˈlæst ˈtaɪm, aɪ ˈsɔː ˈpiːpəl ˈniːlɪŋ ɪn ðə ˈtɛmpəl ˈðɛr. duː aɪ ˈhæf tə ˈniːl, ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, you don't have to kneel. But when you sit down, you mustn't point your feet at the Buddha.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, juː ˈdoʊnt ˈhæf tə ˈniːl. bʌt wɛn juː ˈsɪt ˈdaʊn, juː ˈmʌsənt ˈpɔɪnt jʊr ˈfiːt ət ðə ˈbuːdə.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's a lot of rules! I hope I don't behave badly by mistake.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈruːlz! aɪ ˈhoʊp aɪ ˈdoʊnt bɪˈheɪv ˈbædli baɪ mɪˈsteɪk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Just be respectful. That's the most important thing.
dialogue.reading: ˈdʒʌst bi rɪˈspɛktfəl. ðæts ðə ˈmoʊst ɪmˈpɔːrtənt ˈθɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Thanks, Nam. I'll be on my best behavior!
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks, ˈnɑːm. aɪl bi ɑːn maɪ ˈbɛst bɪˈheɪvjər!
